scope: DMZ presentation and 3D assets; article text, photographs, captions, metadata, JSON-LD and links preserved
checks: MAP/live projection agreement within 0.72 CSS pixels

measurements.environment: Same desktop in-app Chromium browser; single 6-second forward/reverse sweep per scenario. Mobile dimensions are viewport simulation, not a physical phone.
measurements.note: Final cleanup removed one small grass mesh after measurement; it added no render work. Frame times are local observations and do not guarantee equivalent performance on other devices.
